phase: Follow-up ownership + in-flow rendering. Follow-up sets are bound to exactly ONE assistant answer (parentMessageId) from ONE generation (generationId) + sourceAnswerId; only the LATEST answer renders its set. Tapping any follow-up synchronously invalidates the previous set (no old Q2/Q3 surviving), appends the selected question, and enters a loading state; the new answer then renders with the new set directly BELOW it, in normal document flow (position: static, no overlay). Final rendered count is always exactly 3 (server items -> scenario fallback -> deterministic filler; dedup + exclude selected; shared topicAnchorId; ladder action_entry/cognitive_gap/validation_loop). Rapid double/triple tap guarded to one request.
scope: pages/ai-chat/ai-chat.js (message ids, ownership state, tap guard, exact-3 completion, scroll-into-view) + pages/ai-chat/ai-chat.wxml (follow-ups rendered inside the answer block within the scroll-view) + pages/ai-chat/ai-chat.wxss (.follow-section position:static) + pages/ai-chat/followupOwnership.js (new pure helper) + tests/rc8.11/stage2d-followup-ui.test.js (new, matrix A-I) + tests/rc8.11/stage2bc.test.js (updated to ownership fields) + tests/rc8.11/run.js + .changes/current-change.json.
